description: This is a Service Worker JavaScript file that handles install, activate, and fetch events, primarily for managing service worker lifecycle and fetch events in a web application.

methods.name: install event listener
methods.description: Handles the 'install' event to activate the service worker immediately.

methods.name: activate event listener
methods.description: Handles the 'activate' event to take control of clients immediately.

methods.name: fetch event listener
methods.description: Logs every fetch request to the console.
